dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: A tranquil teahouse, with finely crafted ornamentation and the scent of tea lingering in the air...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Mm... The atmosphere here is truly delightful.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: When you can spare the time, why not join me to discuss our favorite poetry over tea?
